feature.name: Local Design Token Studio and responsive original preview
feature.objective: Provide a zero-cost browser-local token editor with live accessible preview, contrast calculations, and safe CSS/JSON export.
feature.audience: Designers and engineers using the unified UI repository
acceptance_criteria: Three selectable original design presets, customizable colors/font/radius/density.
Responsive preview at desktop/tablet/mobile without executing third-party code.
Both selected body and primary action color pairs checked for WCAG AA 4.5:1.
Validated bounded JSON import; deterministic safe CSS and JSON export; browser-local persistence.
Existing source explorer and tool directory work unchanged; all applicable CI checks pass.

source_of_truth.authority_rule: Original source owned within repository; no third-party visual frame or copied implementation is used.

design_system.contrast_review: Two specific color pairs computed in studio; not full accessibility audit.

component_registry.purpose: Responsive original example illustrating the current token set

interactions.success_condition: Validated token set immediately updates sample preview and stored theme
interactions.failure_condition: Invalid name restored with accessible feedback

interactions.success_condition: Valid JSON accepted or CSS/JSON file downloaded
interactions.failure_condition: Malformed or oversized file leaves current theme unchanged
interactions.cancellation_or_undo: Export prior version as portable backup

data_contracts.error_state: invalid import leaves current state intact

tool_runs.decisions: No external runtime or paid tools used
Use mobile/desktop viewport checks and import/export assertions

quality_gates.contrast: two WCAG AA normal-text pairs computed
quality_gates.security_review: Strict whitelisted token schema, no external code or network calls

decisions.decision: Original static sample dashboard rather than arbitrary third-party live code preview
decisions.reason: Avoid executing untrusted or licensed component code while preserving zero-spend architecture.

decisions.decision: Use CSS variables and browser-local persistence
decisions.reason: Portable token contract without adding paid services or global UI frameworks.

handoff.next_stage: Validate browser workflow and review before merging
